dct_description_sm: This Voice of the People poll seeks the opinions of Canadians, on predominantly economic, political, and social issues.  The questions ask opinions of corruption in society, incidences of bribery, education system, health care, and opinion of international organizations, including humanitarian aid organizations. There are also questions on other topics of interest such as internet use, politics, foreign investment in Canada, women and equal rights, United States' foreign policy, and donations to charity. The respondents were also asked questions so that they could be grouped according to geographic and social variables.    Topics of interest include: global issues; neutrality of international humanitarian efforts; health care; politics; education system; bribery; corruption; global institutions; and women.  Basic demographic variables are also included.
dct_title_s: Voice of the People, 1st Edition Survey, 2006, [Canada]
